{{Top|leg}}
A '''Core Worlds Visa''' was a set of [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] which provided information about an individual and their need to travel within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was required to be in possession of these documents in order to move about the Core.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
